steps.content: Countless daggers surge from some unknown space, hurtling toward Kisugi Hitomi, each aimed at a vital point. Yet even in this desperate moment, she feels her heart pounding wildly, an eerie sensation flooding through her entire body.
Under this baptism of blades, her senses grow ever sharper, her movement ever more nimble.
She raises her arm, spins, rolls, leaps...
The whirling attacks hurtling toward her seem to slow in Kisugi Hitomi's eyes.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Hitomi, now!
The attack hesitates, just a fraction of a second. It's the opening Kisugi Hitomi has been waiting for.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: It was fun, little rabbit.
One, two, three... The daggers flying out from the unknown space grow fewer. Kisugi Hitomi dodges each with feline grace, leaping lightly into the air.
With such elegant and nimble evasion, even Miss Rabbit fails to catch her in the end.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: Ai!
Her little sister's voice comes through the comms, and as if in response, the security shutter Kisugi Ai had infiltrated earlier starts to slide down.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: Little rabbit… you said you'd tell me one thing I wished to know.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: What's your name?
The shutter grinds downward, sealing the path. Miss Rabbit doesn't advance. Hearing Kisugi Hitomi's question, a low, amused chuckle escapes her.

steps.speaker: Pricilla
steps.content: You may call me Pricilla, dear phantom thieves.

steps.speaker: Pricilla
steps.content: And I can offer more than a name. Transporting you and the others to this hall... that was my "ability."
Pricilla stops. She simply watches, silent, as the lowering shutter slowly obscures Kisugi Hitomi from sight.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: Ability? What do you mean? Is that related to Mania?

steps.speaker: Pricilla
steps.content: I wish you... continued success.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: What do you mean by that?!
The shutter seals shut without a gap. No response comes through. Her final question hangs, unanswered; it probably didn't make it across.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Hitomi, did something happen?

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: It's nothing serious. Perfect timing with the shutter. I managed to shake them off, thanks to you.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Well done, Hitomi.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: But that woman... she said some strange things. I don't understand what she meant...
Boom—!!
A sharp boom echoes through the line. On the other end of the comms, her sisters jolt. After a second of stunned silence, their voices rush in, calling for Kisugi Hitomi.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Hitomi, are you alright?! Did you trigger a device?
Smoke, thick and bitter, floods the hall. From under a fire safety panel, a shape emerges: Kisugi Hitomi.
She shrugs off the protective gear covering her—lightweight but sturdy as armor—fans the air clear, and switches her earpiece on.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: Must have tripped an anti-theft countermeasure.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: But I'm alright. One of the gadgets Ai wove into my suit just saved my life.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Hehe. I'm just glad I could be of help, Hitomi!
The smoke thins slightly. Through the pale white haze, something like a laser glimmers. The scattered dots connect, forming what looks like a mask floating in midair.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: What... is this...?

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Hitomi, don't move! Those sensors are linked to the firewall! It's running high-level security protocols!
Through the earpiece comes the rapid clatter of keystrokes. Kisugi Ai sits atop a building, battling away against the howling wind.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Actually, there were traps all along the route, but those were just basic. If I had to guess, they were just to keep you busy with that rabbit girl.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: But these in the room... they're different.
A rhythm of light fills the exhibition space, blue and green fading in and out. But now and again, a sudden orange-red flash erupts, swallowing the softer colors.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Whoever we're dealing with now... they're for real.
The rhythm of typing sharpens, quickens. Inside a tight nest of monitors, a Sinner—her hair a light blue-purple—allows a faint, interested smile as her fingers dance over the keys.
Fast reactions, sharp instincts...
Finally, a worthy match.
With this... let's see what you do next.
The lights pulse, cycling through colors with increasing speed. Kisugi Hitomi holds her ground, tense and alert, cautious to approach.
Then, through her earpiece, her little sister's voice comes through—usually so bright and energetic, now hushed and completely earnest.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Hitomi, I think I've figured out their pattern.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Do you trust me? I'll clear the path for you.
A flicker of surprise crosses Kisugi Hitomi's face, yet she responds without a moment's hesitation.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: I trust you, Ai. Tell me what to do!
On the rooftop, Kisugi Ai sets her jaw and taps the keyboard again.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Hitomi, I'll guide you. My directions will also signal Ai which node to disable.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: After each command, you will have only 15 seconds, Ai. But we believe in you. You can do this.
A beat of silence fills the earpiece, followed by a resolute reply.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Let's begin. I'm ready.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Northwest, 20 meters.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Obstacle cleared.
The panel lights shift from blue-green to orange-red. Kisugi Hitomi steps forward without breaking stride.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Southeast, 20 meters.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Obstacle... cleared.

steps.speaker: Tetra
steps.content: Hm? The kitty cats are coming this way?

steps.speaker: Tetra
steps.content: Are you sure about this...?
With the countdown pulsing on the screen, the Sinner's hands are frozen above the keyboard, eyes unblinking.

steps.speaker: Pricilla
steps.content: Hey, Chief said not to "take them out."

steps.speaker: Pricilla
steps.content: Don't get carried away.

steps.speaker: Tetra
steps.content: Mm, fine, fine. It's just... it's been so long since I've had a real challenge. I might have gotten a little excited.

steps.speaker: Tetra
steps.content: See? She's already caught on.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Hitomi, stop right now! Go left! I repeat, don't go southeast!
The command cracks through her earpiece. Kisugi Hitomi yanks herself backward, pivots, and plants her foot in a new direction.

Behind her, the amber-lit corridor is engulfed by a sudden wash of cyan, sealing it off. Behind her, the corridor's warm orange light is violently consumed by a cold, cyan blaze, sealing the path she'd just fled.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Keep going, Hitomi. We're almost there.
Amid the echo of keystrokes, Kisugi Hitomi comes to a stop before the shutter. Then, one final, forceful strike rings out. It must be her little sister's victory.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: My head's spinning... Hitomi... Rui...

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: It's all up to you now.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: You've worked hard, Ai. You did an amazing job.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: We're so proud of you, Ai.
A silence fills the earpiece, leaving only the sigh of wind and a steady breath.
The shutter slowly lifts, revealing the artwork depicting angels before Kisugi Hitomi's eyes.
